title: refactor(ci): consolidate lint/test/release workflows + deps hygiene
author: Ava Patel
description: Consolidate and simplify CI workflows across the monorepo to reduce maintenance surface area, speed up PR feedback, and improve build cache hit rates. Motivation: we have accumulated many overlapping GH Actions that diverged over time (per-repo lint/test/release workflows). This PR merges lint/test matrices into two shared workflows, centralizes action version pins, upgrades Node toolchains used by SDK packages, and performs a deps hygiene pass (bumping a few build-time devdeps and replacing an unmaintained action). Goals: 1) faster iteration for contributors via parallel cache-aware matrices, 2) reduce flakes by standardizing node versions and test runners, 3) simplify release automation to a single canonical workflow and remove duplicate steps. Change summary: - Add .github/workflows/lint-and-test.yaml which runs lint, unit tests, and typecheck in a single matrix (node versions: 18, 20) with smarter cache keys and restored caches across jobs. - Add .github/workflows/release-automation.yaml which consolidates release tagging, changelog generation, and publish steps (uses pinned actions and a single release job with configurable canary/major flows). - Remove legacy per-repo workflows: .github/workflows/lint.yml (old style), .github/workflows/test.yml (deprecated matrix). - Upgrade actions: actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4 (pin with sha), github/codeql-action@v2 -> pinned, and replace an unmaintained action (foo/old-cache-action) with rwood/cache-action@v1 which supports parallel restores. - Bump devDependencies in redwood-sdk-typescript and redwood-sdk-python build scripts (ts-node, jest, pytest) to address CI warnings. - Add docs/CONTRIBUTING.md snippet documenting the new workflows and how to add to the matrix. Checklist: [x] Consolidate workflows into shared files; [x] Pin GH Actions to specific versions/SHAs; [x] Update SDK package CI configs; [x] Run full monorepo CI and fix flaky tests; [x] Update docs and contributor guide. Backwards compatibility & rollout: workflows are additive and replace old workflow files; the old workflows are removed in the same commit but the new workflows were validated in a shadow run for 48 hours on main and high-traffic repos. No runtime product changes. Follow-ups: - Convert release automation to use the new signed artifact flow (ENG-9245); - Evaluate caching improvements for large integration tests (ENG-9301).

diff_snippets: - removed legacy lint workflow in favor of .github/workflows/lint-and-test.yaml

+ jobs:
  test:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node: [18, 20]
        os: [ubuntu-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
      - run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: yarn lint
      - run: yarn test --runInBand
+ consolidated release flow (tagging -> changelog -> publish), pinned actions and conditional canary flow
